changelog.note: 127 (5th group, round B; backlog Q-pro-forma-JEV): JEV could not tell the Számlázz.hu pro formas from invoices (0.47-0.52 on 3 of 4), because both entries separated them by timing, which the page does not show, and proforma_invoice.not_for described the pro formas themselves (serial number, VAT breakdown). Now the document's own title decides: proforma_invoice.what (after its first clause), not_for and examples, invoice_hu.what (after its first clause), the last sentence of its not_for and one example; an advance invoice (előlegszámla) or an invoice issued on a díjbekérő is an invoice. The first clauses GPT is shown are unchanged, so the GPT detection instructions are byte-identical. New cache key for every JEV detection question: the detection baseline is re-measured.

122 (GPT round approved on 2026-10-07): (1) backlog Q-gpt-foreign-receipt (the owner's decision of 2026-10-02 'fix the type description'): the receipt's first clause - the one GPT is shown - names the Hungarian issuer and sends a foreign business's receipt to invoice_foreign, as invoice_foreign already says; receipt.not_for and an invoice_foreign example say the same. (2) backlog F-pro-forma (the owner's decision of 2026-10-02 'new type: pro forma invoice'): new type proforma_invoice in the invoice family; invoice_hu and payment_reminder point to it. New cache key for every detection question: the detection baseline is re-measured.
kiszervezés a Python-konstansokból (ROADMAP §1 konfig mint adat); tartalom változatlan; Upwork-policy 2026-09-20 a két számla-leírásban

regiszter-séma v2 (BACKLOG regiszter-séma): description -> what + not_for + examples + parent (családok: invoice_like, contract_like, bank_like, official_like, other); a Choice-kritérium strukturált objektum; a leírások tartalma változatlan, a not_for a testvér-típusokra mutat
066 Á13: anonimizálás - egy valódi adószám a példában kitalált, ellenőrzőszám-helyes értékre cserélve (a kritérium jelentése változatlan; új gyorsítótár-kulcs, felismerési etalon kell)

unknown.what: The document cannot be read (garbled or empty text) or does not fit any listed type even loosely.
unknown.not_for: A readable document that fits 'other' or any listed type (other).
examples: Garbled font / empty text layer
Scanned image with no usable text

parents.invoice_like: Documents that demand or confirm a payment: invoices, utility bills, receipts, payment reminders, pro forma invoices.
parents.contract_like: Agreements and the confirmations of their performance.
parents.official_like: Certificates, attestations and tax authority forms.

types.what: Supplier invoice (számla) ISSUED BY A HUNGARIAN business or private entrepreneur: the issuer has a Hungarian tax number (adószám ########-#-##), Hungarian labels (számla sorszáma, teljesítés, fizetési határidő, áfa), HUF amounts, often a Számlázz.hu / NAV Online Számlázó / Billzone footer; a title, when printed, calls it an invoice (SZÁMLA, ELEKTRONIKUS SZÁMLA, e-számla, ELŐLEGSZÁMLA, VÉGSZÁMLA). Advance invoices (előlegszámla) and invoices issued on the basis of an earlier díjbekérő or előlegbekérő are invoices. The ISSUER's nationality decides, not the language of the text.
types.not_for: A foreign issuer billing a Hungarian buyer, even in Hungarian (invoice_foreign). A Hungarian freelancer billing THROUGH A FOREIGN PLATFORM (Upwork etc.) in English / USD with no Hungarian tax number (invoice_foreign - policy 2026-09-20: the FORM decides). Hungarian utility bills for electricity, gas, water, waste (utility_bill_hu). A receipt or payment confirmation without VAT breakdown (receipt). A dunning letter about unpaid invoices (payment_reminder). A document whose own title or number label names it a payment request or pro forma (DÍJBEKÉRŐ, PROFORMA SZÁMLA, ELŐLEGBEKÉRŐ), even with a full invoice layout, VAT breakdown and fulfilment date (proforma_invoice).
examples: Számla sorszáma: INF-2022-3, Adószám: 21357912-1-13, Fizetési határidő
Számlázz.hu / NAV Online Számlázó footer, Bruttó összesen ... Ft
Egyéni vállalkozó (kisadózó) számlája, AAM áfa
SZÁMLA / ELŐLEGSZÁMLA issued on the basis of an earlier díjbekérő or előlegbekérő (advance or final invoice)

types.what: Invoice or receipt ISSUED BY A NON-HUNGARIAN business: EU VAT id like IE8256796U / DE123456789, foreign legal form (Ltd, GmbH, Inc, s.r.o.), EUR / USD / PLN / TRY amounts, 'reverse charge', English / German / Polish / Turkish labels (invoice, Rechnung, faktura, fatura). Includes foreign online services (Upwork, Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, Canva, Alza) billing a Hungarian buyer even when the text is Hungarian, and invoices of Hungarian freelancers issued through Upwork in English / USD without a Hungarian tax number (policy 2026-09-20: the form decides, not the issuer's nationality).
types.not_for: An invoice whose issuer has a Hungarian tax number ########-#-## and Hungarian labels (invoice_hu). A bank or card statement listing many transactions (bank_statement). A payment confirmation or order confirmation that is not an invoice (receipt). An event or travel ticket (ticket).
examples: Invoice, VAT ID IE8256796U, reverse charge, EUR
Rechnung Nr., USt-IdNr. DE..., Betrag
Upwork invoice in USD for a Hungarian freelancer
Receipt of a foreign online service: amount paid in USD, card ending, Inc. / Ltd issuer

types.what: Hungarian utility bill (közüzemi számla): electricity (villamos energia, kWh, MVM Next, ELMŰ), gas (földgáz, m3, MJ), water / sewage (víz, csatorna, Vízművek, FCSM), waste (MOHU, hulladék), district heating, or a Díjbeszedő 'Terhelési összesítő' aggregator statement. Has meter readings, consumption, billing period, customer id (felhasználó azonosító) and a payable amount. It IS an invoice, but of the utility kind.
types.not_for: An ordinary supplier invoice for goods or services without meter readings or consumption (invoice_hu). A reminder about an unpaid utility bill (payment_reminder). A bank statement (bank_statement).
examples: MVM Next elszámoló számla, mérőállás, kWh, felhasználási hely
Fővárosi Vízművek részszámla, m3, elszámolási időszak
Díjbeszedő Terhelési összesítő

types.what: A receipt or payment confirmation from a Hungarian issuer that is NOT a full invoice (a foreign business's receipt is invoice_foreign): nyugta, pénztári nyugta, card / vPOS payment confirmation, NAV Online Számla befogadás visszaigazolás, order confirmation with a payment. Typically no buyer tax number and no VAT breakdown per item.
types.not_for: A full invoice with invoice number, issuer tax number and VAT breakdown (invoice_hu / invoice_foreign). A receipt or payment confirmation of a NON-HUNGARIAN business, e.g. a foreign online service paid by card (invoice_foreign). A bank statement with many transactions (bank_statement). A certificate or official confirmation without a payment (certificate).
examples: Nyugta, tranzakció azonosító, bankkártya
NAV Online Számla - befogadás visszaigazolás, érkeztetési szám
Payment confirmation / order confirmation with the amount paid

types.what: Bank account statement (bankszámlakivonat / számlakivonat / account statement): opening and closing balance (nyitó / záró egyenleg), a list of transactions with dates, counterparties and amounts, bank branding (CIB, Erste, OTP, K&H, Raiffeisen, Revolut, Wise).
types.not_for: A single payment confirmation or receipt (receipt). An invoice from the bank for its fees (invoice_hu / invoice_foreign). A tax authority account statement, adófolyószámla (tax_return).
examples: CIB Bank számlakivonat, nyitó egyenleg, záró egyenleg, tranzakciók
Erste account statement, booking date, counterparty, amount
Revolut / Wise statement

types.what: Contract or terms: szerződés, megállapodás, általános szerződési feltételek (ÁSZF), terms and conditions, megbízási / vállalkozási / bérleti szerződés, an offer accepted as a contract (ajánlat + elfogadás). Long prose with numbered clauses, parties, signatures; no invoice totals.
types.not_for: A performance / completion certificate that references a contract but confirms delivered work for a period (performance_certificate). An offer or quote not yet accepted (other). An invoice referencing a contract number (invoice_hu / invoice_foreign).
examples: Megbízási szerződés, felek, számozott pontok, aláírás
Általános Szerződési Feltételek (ÁSZF)
Terms and Conditions: this Agreement is made between

types.what: Entry ticket or pass (belépőjegy, jegy azonosító, szektor / gate / sor / szék, stadium, event ticket, e-bilet for an event or travel), including season passes and QR / barcode tickets.
types.not_for: The invoice or receipt for buying a ticket (invoice_foreign / receipt). An event invitation or programme without an admission ticket (other).
examples: Belépőjegy, szektor, sor, szék, QR-kód
E-bilet, gate, seat, barcode
Season pass / bérlet with a ticket id

types.what: Certificate, attestation or official confirmation: tanúsítvány, igazolás, oklevél, bizonyítvány, NAV adóigazolás / köztartozásmentes igazolás, cégkivonat, registration certificate. Issued by an authority or institution about a person or company; no amounts to pay.
types.not_for: A performance certificate confirming delivered work for invoicing (performance_certificate). A tax return form or tax authority decision with field codes (tax_return). A payment receipt (receipt).
examples: NAV adóigazolás / köztartozásmentes igazolás
Cégkivonat, tanúsítvány, oklevél
Registration certificate issued by an authority

types.what: Tax return or tax authority form / decision: adóbevallás, NAV bevallás (pl. 2265, 2508, ÁNYK), adófolyószámla, határozat, felszólítás from NAV; official form layout with field codes.
types.not_for: A tax certificate or attestation issued about a company (certificate). A supplier invoice mentioning VAT (invoice_hu). A dunning letter from a supplier, not from the tax authority (payment_reminder).
examples: NAV 2265 bevallás, ÁNYK nyomtatvány, mezőkódok
Adófolyószámla kivonat
NAV határozat, felszólítás

types.what: Performance / completion certificate (teljesítésigazolás, teljesítés-igazolás, TIG, időráfordítás alapú teljesítés igazolása, munkalap, timesheet accepted by the customer): the CUSTOMER confirms that the supplier performed the contracted work for a period, usually referencing a framework contract (keretszerződés) and listing hours / days / deliverables, signed by both parties. It precedes the invoice.
types.not_for: The invoice itself - it has an invoice number and VAT breakdown (invoice_hu / invoice_foreign). The contract or framework agreement being referenced (contract). An official certificate issued by an authority (certificate).
examples: Teljesítésigazolás, keretszerződés száma, időszak, munkanapok
TIG - időráfordítás alapú teljesítés igazolása
Timesheet approved by the customer, signed by both parties

types.what: Payment reminder or dunning letter (fizetési felszólítás, fizetési emlékeztető, tartozás, hátralék, késedelmi kamat, 'lejárt számla') referring to one or more unpaid invoices; not the invoice itself.
types.not_for: The invoice being reminded about (invoice_hu / invoice_foreign / utility_bill_hu). A tax authority demand (tax_return). A statement of an account balance without a demand (bank_statement). A pro forma invoice that asks for payment before any invoice is issued (proforma_invoice).
examples: Fizetési felszólítás, lejárt számla, késedelmi kamat
Fizetési emlékeztető, tartozás, hátralék
Payment reminder: overdue invoice

types.what: Pro forma invoice or payment request (díjbekérő, proforma számla, előlegbekérő) that asks for payment BEFORE the invoice is issued: the document's own title or number label names it a payment request or pro forma (DÍJBEKÉRŐ, Díjbekérő sorszáma, PROFORMA SZÁMLA, ELŐLEGBEKÉRŐ). Otherwise it may look exactly like an invoice - issuer tax number, buyer, serial number, line items with VAT rate and VAT amount, gross total, fulfilment, issue and due dates, an invoicing-software footer such as Számlázz.hu - because the same software prints both; the document's own title decides, not the layout. Some also state that it is not an invoice (nem számla, nem adóügyi bizonylat) or that the invoice follows the payment.
types.not_for: A document whose title names it an invoice (SZÁMLA, ELEKTRONIKUS SZÁMLA, e-számla, ELŐLEGSZÁMLA, VÉGSZÁMLA), even when it refers to an earlier or paid díjbekérő or előlegbekérő ('a ... díjbekérő alapján', 'Kifizetett díjbekérő sorszáma') or bills or deducts an advance payment (előleg): an advance invoice (előlegszámla) is an invoice (invoice_hu / invoice_foreign). A dunning letter about an unpaid invoice (payment_reminder). An offer or quote that does not request payment (other). A receipt or confirmation of a payment already made (receipt).
examples: DÍJBEKÉRŐ title, Sorszám, Teljesítés dátuma, Fizetési határidő, items with Áfa % and Bruttó ár - invoice-style layout from invoicing software
Proforma számla - nem számla, áfa levonására nem jogosít
Előlegbekérő a megrendelés előlegéről, a számlát a befizetés után állítjuk ki

types.what: A readable business document that is none of the listed types: letter, offer / quote (ajánlat, árajánlat), delivery note (szállítólevél), meeting minutes, map data, presentation, form, marketing material, ID document.
types.not_for: Anything that fits a listed type even loosely. Unreadable or garbled text (unknown).
examples: Árajánlat / ajánlat not yet accepted
Szállítólevél, jegyzőkönyv, meghívó
Presentation, form, ID document
